title: pkix-chain Verifier missing Debug derive
description:
In pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:426, struct Verifier<'a, V, R, A> holds references to the four validation components but does not derive Debug (or any trait beyond the implicit auto-traits). Per the coding standards, Debug should be derived on almost everything.

What goes wrong: Callers cannot println!("{:?}", verifier) for diagnostic logging. This is a small ergonomic gap but worth fixing since the four inner references all point to types that typically impl Debug.

Location: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:426

Recommendation: Add #[derive(Debug)] with appropriate V: Debug, R: Debug, A: Debug bounds (or use a manual Debug impl that prints the type without requiring Debug on the generics). Also consider Copy/Clone if all fields are shared references.
